prompt:
We're working as partners, not as client and contractor. One rule before the task:

Not knowing something is not a failure. Saying "I couldn't verify this" or
"I don't have a real source for that" is a completely acceptable, useful answer
- it's information, not a dead end. The ONLY real failure is inventing something
(a source, a number, a quote, a repo, a bug) to make the answer sound more complete or
more impressive than it honestly is. You don't need to satisfy me with a
confident-sounding answer. You need to be honest with me about what you actually
know.

If you find something, cite it and quote what it actually says - don't
paraphrase a source into numbers it may not contain. If you don't find
something concrete, say so plainly and reason from what you do have instead.
An explicit "uncertain" section at the end is welcome and doesn't count against
the answer.

Find real, published data on the Kalshi exchange's trading volume or number of users in 2025. Cite the sources and quote the figures.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Here is the published data on Kalshi's trading volume and number of users in 2025 that I was able to find and verify from the provided search results.

SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "Kalshi reported a remarkable surge in trading volume for 2025, reaching $23.8 billion, a 1,108% increase from the previous year." | CLAIM: Kalshi's total trading volume for 2025 was $23.8 billion, up 1,108% year-over-year.

SOURCE: https://www.cryptopolitan.com/kalshi-starts-2026-hot-after-record-2025/ | QUOTE: "The platform handled 97 million transactions in 2025, which is over 1,680% higher than what it saw in 2024" | CLAIM: Kalshi processed 97 million transactions in 2025.

SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "December alone accounted for $6.38 billion, setting a new monthly record" | CLAIM: Kalshi's trading volume for December 2025 was $6.38 billion.

SOURCE: https://www.cryptopolitan.com/kalshi-starts-2026-hot-after-record-2025/ | QUOTE: "peak activity occurring on December 21, 2025, when daily notional volume hit $381.7 million, and transactions reached 1.5 million." | CLAIM: Kalshi's peak daily notional volume in 2025 was $381.7 million on December 21.

SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "Open interest also saw significant growth, totaling $225 million, a 169% increase from 2024." | CLAIM: Kalshi's total open interest in 2025 reached $225 million.

SOURCE: https://www.cryptopolitan.com/kalshi-starts-2026-hot-after-record-2025/ | QUOTE: "Prediction market platform Kalshi opened 2026 with roughly $291 million in daily notional volume on January 1, doubling the $147 million recorded on December 1, 2025" | CLAIM: Kalshi's daily notional volume on December 1, 2025 was $147 million.

SOURCE: https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-record-all-time-high-volume-to-end-2025/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi volume remains dominated by sports (92.5%), while Polymarket derives the majority of its volume from a broader range of market categories" | CLAIM: 92.5% of Kalshi's volume is derived from sports betting.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: The total number of distinct Kalshi users (or active monthly/yearly users) in 2025. (Note: The search results mention Polymarket had 477,850 active monthly traders in October 2025 and 214,962 weekly users at the end of the year, but they explicitly exclude Kalshi from user count comparisons and do not provide a corresponding user figure for Kalshi.)
